items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: We had in the show a lady by name of Avis Andrews, beautiful singer

ctx.x: So is to talk bad to some of those guys, you know what I mean. I used to say, oh, I hope this man never (inaudible). I hope. We are good friend, and I don't, you know, you never can tell. So we were working, and I think we were up around -- somewhere around Detroit or somewhere around there, the theater.

We had in the show a lady by name of Avis Andrews, beautiful singer, had some beautiful arrangements, you know. And some of the effects used to play in the Derby. If you play in the Derby, you got to be careful. If you put home too much
(inaudible) some notes, you be out of tune, because (inaudible). So he ran (inaudible), he say, get your (inaudible). I got to hear the sound right.
